import urllib.request, json, os, time, base64

gitea_base = os.getenv('GITEA_URL', 'http://<AAP_HOST>:3000')
pr_number  = os.getenv('PR_NUMBER', '')
username   = os.getenv('GITEA_USER', 'demo-admin')
password   = os.getenv('GITEA_PASS', '')
owner      = os.getenv('REPO_OWNER', 'demo-admin')
repo       = os.getenv('REPO_NAME', 'config-service')

if not pr_number:
    raise Exception('PR_NUMBER not set - check set_stats in App GitOps Remediate playbook')

creds = base64.b64encode(f'{username}:{password}'.encode()).decode()
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}

def get(url):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    return json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10).read().decode())

print(f'Waiting for PR #{pr_number} to be merged in Gitea...')
merge_sha = None
for _ in range(60):
    pr = get(f'{gitea_base}/api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{pr_number}')
    if pr.get('merged'):
        merge_sha = pr.get('merge_commit_sha', '')
        print(f'PR #{pr_number} merged: {merge_sha[:8]}')
        break
    if pr.get('state') == 'closed' and not pr.get('merged'):
        raise Exception(f'PR #{pr_number} closed without merging')
    time.sleep(30)
else:
    raise Exception('Timeout: PR not merged after 30 minutes')

print('Waiting for Gitea Actions CI pipeline to complete...')
for i in range(40):
    runs = get(f'{gitea_base}/api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?limit=5')
    items = runs.get('workflow_runs', runs.get('items', []))
    matching = [r for r in items if merge_sha[:8] in r.get('head_sha', '')]
    if matching:
        run = matching[0]
        status = run.get('status', '')
        conclusion = run.get('conclusion', '')
        if status == 'completed' or conclusion in ('success',):
            print(json.dumps({'ci_passed': True,'run_id': str(run.get('id', '')),'conclusion': conclusion or status,'pr_number': pr_number,'merge_sha': merge_sha}))
            break
        if conclusion in ('failure', 'cancelled'):
            raise Exception(f'Gitea CI failed: {conclusion}')
    time.sleep(30)
else:
    raise Exception('Timeout: Gitea CI not completed after 20 minutes')
